senses.gloss: pr. n. pl.Sepphoris in Upper Galilee.
units: Meg. 6ᵃ קטרון זו צ׳ וכ׳ Kitron (Jud. I, 30) is Sepphoris, and why is it named S.? Because it is perched on the top of a mountain like a bird (tsippor).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 75b:10">B. Bath. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>אני ראיתי צ׳ בשלותה</he> I have seen S. in her prosperous days.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:7">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ</cite> top <he>רבי … בצ׳ וכ׳</he> Rabbi lived in S. seventeen years.

<cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 9:6">Arakh. IX, 6</cite> <he>קצרה … של ציפורים</he> the old castle of S. (a fortification dating from the days of the lsraelitish conquest); Bab. ed. (32ᵃ) <cite ref="R00413"><he>ציפורי</he></cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 3:6">Ex. R. s. 3</cite>, a. e. <cite ref="R00418"><he>ציפורן</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
